title: Copilot for Eclipse Open Source
description: GitHub Copilot for Eclipse is now open source, making the codebase available for community contribution and transparency.

title: Semantic Issue Search in Copilot Chat
description: GitHub released semantic issue search functionality in Copilot Chat, enabling more intelligent code issue discovery and resolution.

title: Auto Model Selection Based on Task in VS Code
description: Copilot now automatically routes to appropriate models based on the specific task being performed in VS Code, improving efficiency and accuracy.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Generally Available
description: Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash model is now generally available for GitHub Copilot users, providing faster AI assistance.

title: Bug Fixes and Improvements (v2.3.9)
description: Fixed availability issues with swe-check model for some users, improved terminal processing performance, restored conversation sharing, and repaired path resolution for the Devin local agent on WSL.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex Base Model for Business and Enterprise
description: GPT-5.3-Codex is now the base model for Copilot Business and Enterprise tiers, offering improved coding capabilities.

title: Agent View Feature (v2.1.139–v2.1.142)
description: Week 20 (May 11–15, 2026): Introduced Agent view with `claude agents` command that opens one screen for every Claude Code session, showing what's running, what's blocked, and what's done.

title: Platform Default Settings and Slack Improvements
description: Devin added platform default settings (Linux/Windows) for sessions, Slack channel override functionality, and MCP OAuth resource parameter support for better authentication.

title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: Cursor now supports launching Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read threads, understand context, and create PRs in GitHub without leaving Slack conversations.

title: Team-level Usage Metrics via API
description: Team-level Copilot usage metrics are now available via API, giving organizations better visibility into AI adoption and spending.

title: GitHub Copilot App Technical Preview
description: GitHub released a new Copilot app in technical preview, expanding Copilot's accessibility and integration options.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode)
description: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) is now available in Windsurf, with full intelligence of Opus 4.7 but ~2.5x higher output speeds.

title: Deprecation Notice - Transitioning to Antigravity CLI
description: Google announced Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions will stop serving requests on June 18, 2026, transitioning users to Antigravity CLI.

title: GitLab Interactive PR Review
description: GitLab repositories now support interactive PR review in Devin, with the ability to post review comments and resolve threads when read-write GitLab connection is enabled.

title: BugBot Automatic Code Review
description: Cursor 1.0 introduced BugBot for automatic code review that catches potential bugs and issues in PRs, leaving comments directly on GitHub with 'Fix in Cursor' integration.

title: Goal Command and Fast Mode (v2.1.128–v2.1.136)
description: Week 19 (May 4–8, 2026): Introduced `/goal` command that keeps Claude working across turns until completion condition holds. Fast mode now runs on Opus 4.7 by default. Rewind menu can compress earlier context.

title: May 2026 Update - Command Line and UI Improvements
description: Gemini CLI shipped a broad update in May 2026 with command line improvements, core and UI improvements, new session deletion options, commands listing options, and voice mode upgrades.

title: Background Agent General Availability
description: Cursor's remote coding agent (Background Agent) is now available to all users, allowing parallel task execution with cloud icon in chat or Cmd/Ctrl+E shortcut.

title: Devin Review & Quick Review
description: All Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review with existing subscription. Devin Review is available for all self-serve users with a 2 week free trial.

title: Memories Feature Beta
description: Cursor introduced Memories beta feature that allows the AI to remember facts from conversations and reference them in future sessions, stored per project at individual level.
